question: ______ is the first woman hockey player to receive the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rani Rampal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rani Rampal **is the first woman hockey player to receive the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award.**
 
• She was the youngest player in the national team that competed in the 2010 World Cup at the age of 15.
 
• She completed her education but was unable to obtain a graduate degree due to scheduled practice sessions and competitions. On her team, she is a forward.
 
• She has scored **134 goals in 212 international appearances.**
 
• She is the captain of the** Indian Women's Hockey Team** at the moment.
 
• She is also recognised as a striker who frequently plays in the midfield. The Indian government awarded her the Padma Shri in 2020.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Vandana Katariya__ **is an Indian field hockey player who represents her country as a forward. Vandana rose to attention after scoring the most goals for India in the Women's Hockey Junior World Cup in 2013.
 
• **__Nikki Pradhan__ **is a professional field hockey player from India who also plays for the national squad. She was the first female athlete from Jharkhand to compete in the Olympics for India.
 
• **__Sharmila Devi__ **is a field hockey player from India. In the 2019 Women's FIH Olympic Qualifiers, she made her international debut against the USA, scoring a goal.
